information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 3x3x3 "최소회전"만 진행되는 대회입니다. # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCBusan2025#53887-spectator-restriction): 선수 당 1명 ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/60/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/60/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # This competition ONLY holds the 3x3x3 "Fewest Moves" event. # [Spectator Restriction](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCBusan2025#53887-spectator-restriction): 1 per competitor ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/60/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/60/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
